run_kitti_evaluation: run KITTI object detection evaluation on detection results against ground truth labels
run_coco_evaluation: run COCO-style evaluation on KITTI detection results using the coco flag
run_evaluation_with_score_threshold: run KITTI evaluation filtering detections below a confidence score threshold
run_evaluation_for_class: run KITTI evaluation for a specific object class like car or pedestrian
run_evaluation_cli: run the evaluate module via fire CLI with label and result path arguments
